brief:
The US State Department has ordered the departure of some diplomats and family members from its missions in Saudi Arabia, citing Houthi strikes in the region, according to Al-Monitor. The department is also planning to relocate family members from several other US missions across the Gulf.

The move reflects escalating security concerns tied to attacks by the Iranian-backed Houthi movement against targets in the Arabian Peninsula and surrounding waters.

title: US orders diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia over Houthi attacks
